_about: The Mooble (src/mooble_encounter.py, src/game_mooble_dance.py, src/rhythm.py; RARE_PETS_PLAN_2026_11_14 section 2). Every run, on one floor from first_floor to last_floor (never a gate boss's floor, nor a planned mini-boss's while another floor is left), in a quiet side cave off the main floor, the last of the Moobles dances alone on a ledge: a small cream-furred sprite with little bat wings and a red bobble on a wire antenna that glows when he dances. He is 'he' throughout, and he ends what he says with '...pom' (an homage, never a copy: no Square Enix name, word or tune). Meet him and he hints at the miners' Starnut Tart (kitchen recipe tart_recipe, made to carry); give him one and he comes down. Then three dances with gap_turns between (leaving his floor counts as waiting), each a rhythm game: PRACTICE first, free and as often as wanted, then the DANCE-OFF, which must be won (dance.pass_share of the steps hit, no more than dance.max_misses misses). A lost dance-off ends the visit. After the third win 'I choose you' asks the quiz below, and he joins as the support companion (the 'pet' block).
_floor_note: Brandon's floors (2026-11-14). A gate boss's floor (boss_levels.BOSS_LEVELS) is never his; a planned mini-boss's floor only when no other is left.
name: Mooble
_art_standin_note: Until his own pictures are installed (assets/tiles/monsters/<id>.png), an id of his with no file shows this creature's picture, never a letter (mooble_encounter.art). Each of his ids shows its own picture the moment the file is there.
_starnuts_note: Starnuts grow in the cracks of his cave: so many are set down there when he is, so a kid who meets him can always bake the tart.
_gap_turns_note: Turns between one dance-off (won or lost, or a fumbled 'I choose you') and the next try. Leaving his floor counts as waiting. Sooner, and he is still dancing the last one through (too_soon).
_pet_level_note: LORE, NOT FLOOR: he is no hatchling. He has danced every night for years, alone, and joins at level 20 whatever the floor; Mooble Dancer at 25 and Troupe-Leader at 55 (the pet thresholds).

dance._doc: The rhythm game (src/rhythm.py). A count-in of lead_beats, then his phrase over phrase_beats (two bars), then the same beats for the hero to echo it on the arrow keys. A key within good_ms of a step's beat is Good, within perfect_ms Perfect; anything else, or no key, is a Miss, and a key that belongs to no step counts as a miss too. Win: pass_share of the steps hit and no more than max_misses misses. No automatic slowing: tune these after Brandon's play-test.

title: A LONELY DANCER
story: In a quiet side cave the old miners' lamps hang cold upon their hooks, and the only light is a small red glow on a ledge high up the wall. It comes from the bobble on the antenna of a little cream-furred creature with bat wings, who is dancing all alone, a hop, a hop and a spin, and with every step the bobble glows brighter, until he catches sight of you and freezes where he stands.

"Nobody comes down here any more...pom," he says. "The miners used to dance with us every night, to keep the dark back, but they went away, and then the others went quiet one by one. I still dance, but a dance needs a partner...pom."

His stomach growls. "The miners used to bring us Starnut Tarts, made of a starnut, a bread ration and a sweet apple and baked golden. Oh, how I miss a Starnut Tart...pom." He looks from you to the dark, and he does not leave his ledge.
waiting_ledge: The Mooble watches you from his ledge high up the wall of the cave. His bobble glows faintly, and he looks hungry and a little hopeful.
waiting: At the foot of his ledge the Mooble sits licking the last crumbs of the tart from his paws, and often he glances at the empty floor of the cave, where the miners used to dance.
The Mooble bounces on his toes as you come in, and his bobble is a little brighter than it was.
The Mooble is already humming a tune when you come in, and his wings twitch in time with it.
The Mooble hovers before you with his bobble glowing like a lantern, and he looks from you to the way out of his cave and back to you again.
on_ledge: He shakes his head upon his ledge. "I can't dance on an empty stomach, not without a Starnut Tart...pom."
no_tart: You search your pack and find no Starnut Tart, yet he sniffs hopefully for all that. "A starnut, a bread ration and a sweet apple, baked golden...pom," he reminds you.
tart_given: You hold out the Starnut Tart, and the Mooble's ears rise straight up. He glides down from his ledge on his little wings, takes the tart in both paws and eats it in four enormous bites, and when he has licked every crumb from his paws his bobble glows warm and bright. "Just like the miners made...pom!" he cries, and he hops out upon the empty floor of the cave and holds out a paw to you, for he wants to dance.
already_ate: He has eaten his tart, and he is ready to dance. "Tarts are for after...pom!"
dance_won: You finish together. For a moment he bobs, unsure, and looks down at his own feet as if they belonged to somebody else, and then he does the last step again by himself and smiles. "We danced...pom," he whispers.
You finish on the beat together. His bobble glows as bright as a miner's lamp, and for a moment the whole cave is lit. "I had forgotten how that feels...pom," he says.

He spins and laughs, and you spin with him until the old cave rings. When you stop, his bobble is blazing and every corner of the cave is filled with light, and he looks at you a long while before he speaks. "Can I come with you...pom? I don't want to dance alone any more."
all_danced: "We've danced all three...pom!" he says, hovering hopefully before you. "Was there something you wanted to ask me?"
dance_lost: The Mooble's bobble dims. "Not yet...pom," he says kindly. "Come back when your feet have rested, and we'll try again."
too_soon: The Mooble is still dancing the last one through on his own, slowly, step by step. "It's not time for a dance-off yet...pom," he says, "but we can practise."
The Mooble is still dancing the last one through, and he waves you off with a wing. "Not yet...pom. Practise with me if you like."
The Mooble is still dancing the last one through, humming as he goes. "Soon...pom! We can practise while we wait."
_too_soon_note: One line per dance won so far (0, 1, 2): bumped before gap_turns have passed since the last dance-off (or a fumbled ask), he says so; the dance-off (and the ask) wait, and nothing counts, but practice is always on offer (Brandon, 2026-11-14: 'an option to practice as many times as you want before you try it').
refused_ledge: You hold out your hand and say it, but the Mooble only shrinks back upon his ledge. "I don't even know you...pom," he says, while his stomach growls.
refused_dances: "A friend is somebody you've danced with...pom," he says, "and we haven't danced at all."
"One dance is a start...pom," he says. "Dance two more with me, and then ask me again."
"One more dance...pom," he says, and his bobble flickers. "Just one more."
pass: "Pom!" cries the Mooble, and he shoots up into the air, turns a somersault and lands upon your shoulder. Then he hops down to take his place at your side, one step behind, as a partner in the dance waits for the music, and at your back the old cave seems a little less dark.
fail: You try, but the words come out in a jumble, and the Mooble tilts his head. "I don't think you meant that...pom," he says. "Come back and ask me properly."
ignore: You leave the Mooble in his cave, and behind you the little red glow begins to bob again, all alone.

pet._doc: The Mooble as a companion: pet_system loads 'species' into _SPECIES['mooble'] (a quest pet: never from a Soul Sphere). A support companion: small health and weak bites (health_mult, bite_mult on the pet growth table), he keeps near you rather than charging foes (support), lends you mana while near (mana_gift: amount every 'every' turns, by stage, within radius tiles), and dances the Dance of the Dark (the 'lines' below; the Stray Kids' watch rule). At the Troupe-Leader stage the dance also lifts one hindrance from you.

species._nature_note: How he fights beside you (data/pet_tactics.json 'natures'): small and soft, he falls back early when a fight goes badly, and squeaks for help when badly hurt.

specials.name: Dance of the Dark
specials.desc: A dance: a count-in, then his phrase on the arrow keys. The better you dance, the more foes near him stand staring, the longer and the farther (never a named foe, the mindless, the blind, or what cannot be stunned). Danced well, a Troupe-Leader's also lifts one hindrance from you.

special_dance._doc: Dance of the Dark is danced (Brandon, 2026-11-14: 'that should trigger a dance rhythm game as well, where your success determines how powerful it is (no practice, just a count in)'). Using it opens the dance screen: a count-in of lead_beats ('5, 6, 7, 8!'), then his phrase for this stage, danced as its arrows light (no call to watch, no practice). The cooldown is spent when it starts. Monsters do not act during it: it is his turn, like a quiz. The score is rhythm.score (the steps hit over the steps due, a Perfect worth perfect_worth, a stray key costing stray_cost) and the band is the highest whose min_score it reaches: how far it reaches (radius), how long they stare (turns), how many are held at most (max_held, the nearest first), and whether a Troupe-Leader's dance lifts a hindrance (lift). Even a flop does a little.
